Title: Abimelech's Coup at Shechem
DateApprox: c. 1150 BC (approx., during the period of the Judges)
KeyPersons: Abimelech, Son of Gideon; Jotham, Son of Gideon
Events: Gideon's son Abimelech murders his seventy brothers and is made king at Shechem, until Jotham's parable of judgment is fulfilled in civil war and Abimelech's death.
